description: Keyboard module allows listening to native keyboard events, dismissing the keyboard, and syncing UI with keyboard movements.

addListener.description: Connects a JS function to a native keyboard event and returns a reference to the listener.

eventName.description: Name of the keyboard event to listen for.
eventName.note: Only 'keyboardDidShow' and 'keyboardDidHide' are available on Android. Events may not fire on Android 10 or below if windowSoftInputMode is set to adjustResize or adjustNothing.

callback.description: Function to execute when the event fires.

dismiss.description: Dismisses the active keyboard and removes focus from the current input.

scheduleLayoutAnimation.description: Syncs UI layout (e.g., TextInput or keyboard accessory views) with keyboard movements.

event.description: The keyboard event object containing metrics and layout info.

isVisible.description: Returns whether the keyboard is currently visible.

metrics.description: Returns metrics of the soft keyboard if visible.

notes: Useful for controlling UI adjustments when the keyboard appears or disappears.
addListener is the primary method for reacting to keyboard events.
Dismiss the keyboard when tapping outside of TextInput to improve UX.
scheduleLayoutAnimation helps animate input fields along with the keyboard.
